mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as stronger economic activity boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly GDP growth, or GDP growth reverses in the subsequent period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals tightening monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding demand and supply, both driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed their 2011-12-01 values, or the proxies' increase is not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1%), markets anticipate sustained growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with low inflation and near-zero rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the regime, or positive returns occur outside the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as strong labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 5% for the next month, or UNRATE rises above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) creates a virtuous cycle of strong labor markets and economic expansion, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies move in the expected directions, or the interaction effect is weak (e.g., IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in the federal funds rate above 4% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: During an expansion phase defined by quarterly GDP growth exceeding 5%, markets anticipate continued growth and invest positively, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during expansion phases, or positive returns occur outside expansion phases.
